title: Hiding in Plain Sight: Taking Control of Hypertension
subtitle: Learning how to lower your risk of the “silent killer” that is reshaping millions of lives
author: Andrew Li
excerpt: Nearly ¼ Canadian adults suffer from hypertension, but it’s often dismissed as “not serious” simply because there’s no symptoms until it triggers something worse.

title: A Guide to Understanding Mast Cell Activation Syndrome (MCAS)
subtitle: When Your Body's Alarm System Won't Stop Ringing
author: Bernardo Werneck da Costa
excerpt: Mast Cell Activation Syndrome MCAS is an immune condition in which mast cells release excessive chemical mediators in response to ordinary, non-threatening stimuli, producing allergy-like symptoms across multiple organ systems.

title: What is Ebola Disease?
subtitle: Although Ebola is one of the world’s deadliest infectious diseases, current advances in medicine have helped greatly improve the odds of survival and prevention with improved outbreak responses.
author: Elia Ma
excerpt: Ebola can begin with symptoms that look like a common illness, a fever, headache and tiredness, but it can quickly become a serious medical emergency.

title: Antibiotic Resistance: The Threat to Modern Medicine
subtitle: How bacteria are evolving to outsmart our medicines and what we can do to keep antibiotics working.
author: Gerald Szeto
excerpt: Antibiotic resistance could make once-treatable infections significantly more difficult to treat, threatening millions of lives and modern medicine procedures.

title: Breaking the Stigma of Epilepsy
subtitle: A story that is more than just a seizure
author: Isabella Wang
excerpt: When will the next seizure occur? How will it happen? Fear, anxiety, depression. Three factors that surround epilepsy patients every day.

title: Multiple Myeloma, in a way you can understand!
subtitle: When a health diagnosis turns your world upside down, simple and clear information is the first step to getting better!
author: Matthias Seuntjens
excerpt: Receiving an unexpected diagnosis involving defective blood cells infiltrating the bone marrow can feel intimidating. This summary describes multiple myeloma in clear, accessible terms.

title: Beyond the surface: Breaking Down the Physical and Psychological Impacts of Acne Vulgaris
subtitle: How Genetics, Hormones and Daily Habits influence Our Skin and What it Means for Our Mental Wellbeing
author: Maxine Krylov
excerpt: Acne vulgaris is a skin condition that affects 85% of adolescents aged between 12-24 years old. Acne is not only a physical skin condition, but it can also build into psychological distress.

title: Never Too Late: A Guide To Reverse Type 2 Diabetes
subtitle: Frequent thirst. Hunger. Urination. Craving sugar. If your body is trying to talk to you, it’s time to listen.
author: Olivia Wang
excerpt: Most people view diabetes as “eating too much sugar” or “always taking insulin injections,” but it is much more than that.

title: Endometriosis: Living as the Overlooked 10%
subtitle: Discussing the workings of endometriosis and the system that refuses to
author: Sophia Bhatti
excerpt: Endometriosis is a chronic inflammatory disorder affecting up to 10% of women worldwide, which is heavily under researched.

title: Scrolling Past Bedtime
subtitle: How Late-Night Screen Use Affects Sleep, Learning, and Teen Health
author: Stefan Szeto
excerpt: With more than 70% of high school students not getting the recommended 8-10 hours of sleep on school night, millions of teenagers are at risk for sleep deprivation (Uccella et al.).
